stories.title: Integrate Disciplinary Signal into Provider Detail Response Assembly
stories.description: Integrate the disciplinary signal object (presence_indicator, board_url, state, availability_status) into the provider_detail_service response assembly pipeline, ensuring consistent inclusion alongside other evaluation signals without breaking existing response structure.

stories.title: Expose Extended Disciplinary Fields via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Update evaluate_care_facade to include the extended disciplinary signal fields (including availability_status) in provider detail responses returned to the chat layer, ensuring compatibility with existing tool response formats.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Disciplinary Presence and Availability Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating presence_indicator computation and availability_status classification across supported states, unsupported states, and missing state scenarios, ensuring deterministic outputs without external calls.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Disciplinary Signal in Provider Detail Flow
stories.description: Implement integration tests validating that a provider lookup flows through provider_detail_service and evaluate_care_facade and returns a correctly structured disciplinary signal, including edge cases for unsupported or missing state mappings.
